info.name: Cashbook
info.summary: Keep the cashbook of your shop or association
info.description:
Keep the cashbook of your shop or association in Nextcloud.
- Create cashbooks in any currency - Add income and expenses with reason, text, tax rate, receipt number and receipt date - Browse the entries of a cashbook by month, quarter, year or a custom date range, grouped by business day - Print the cashbook of a period - Import cashbooks exported from the SumUp POS Pro (German version)
info.author: Ferdinand Thiessen
